name: CDW
description: CDW is a reseller and integrator of IT: it buys more than 100,000 products and services from over 1,000 vendor partners (Adobe, APC, Apple and others) and resells them to businesses, governments, schools and hospitals with design, procurement, integration and managed services. Hardware (laptops, networking, servers and storage) is 72% of net sales, software 19% and services 9%. Operating margin is 7.4% of net sales. Three vendors each exceeded $2.0 billion of 2025 net sales. About 90% of sales are in the U.S.

employees.note: About 14,800 coworkers (11,200 U.S., 3,600 international); about 10,500 are customer-facing sellers, specialists and engineers. As-of date taken as the 10-K balance date.

businessLines.name: Corporate (US private-sector, over 250 employees)
businessLines.how: Sells IT hardware, software and services to large U.S. companies, earning the spread between vendor cost and the resale price (gross margin 23.3% of segment sales), plus fees on services.

businessLines.name: Small Business (US, up to 250 employees)
businessLines.how: Resale of IT products and services to smaller U.S. businesses at a spread (gross margin 22.8%).

businessLines.name: Public (US government, education, healthcare)
businessLines.how: Resale of IT products and services to federal, state and local agencies, schools and universities, and hospitals, with public-sector contracts a named risk area; lower gross margin (20.2%) than commercial.

businessLines.name: Other (CDW UK and CDW Canada)
businessLines.how: Same reseller model in the UK and Canada; below the reporting threshold so grouped as Other.

brands.name: CDW UK
brands.note: Grouped with CDW Canada in Other; UK and Canada together $2.7B of 2025 net sales.

whatsNext.text: Segments realigned from Corporate, Small Business and Public to Commercial (corporate, financial services, healthcare and small business), Government and Education, with CDW UK and Canada in Other; reported from Q1 2026 (the Q2 2026 10-Q is on the new basis).
